source: make a RNG game where you try to roll for basketball players you have infinite rolls and your trying to make best to build the best team, add all the most popular players from basketball and once you have you team you can join a basketball world cup and try to win against other people

image_prompt.text: Sidelines and baselines around the basketball court, built so play can be stopped the moment the ball or a player crosses them
The centre circle and free-throw positions players and the ball reset to in order to start play
Hoops at each end with the invisible cylinder beneath them that registers a basket

layout_placement.text: A detection perimeter on the court lines for out-of-bounds and foul calls
Static restart positions at the centre circle and the free-throw lines
Scoring volumes inside each hoop that register points

notes: Most of this prompt has no layout job at all. Rolling for players, infinite rolls, roster building and world-cup matchmaking are progression and matchmaking systems; the only space in the game is the court the final matches are played on.
Court Sport was taken as-is. The prompt says world cup, which may well imply a full arena with stands - spectator-bleachers and barrier-perimeter were not added because the user did not ask for them.

open_questions.ask: Should the world cup court read as a real televised arena, or something stylized?
Does the world cup court sit inside a full stadium with crowd stands, or is it just the court?
Is the rolling done on a screen, or do you want a physical draft room in the map to walk around in?

coverage_missing.ask: A real televised arena or something stylized?
Is the court inside a stadium with stands?
Is rolling a screen, or a physical room in the map?
Is the world cup a bracket of matches, or one match against another team?

answers.ask: Should the world cup court read as a real televised arena, or something stylized?
answers.answer: Make it a real televised basketball arena style, matching a World Cup competition.

answers.ask: Does the world cup court sit inside a full stadium with crowd stands, or is it just the court?
answers.answer: Put the court inside a small full stadium with crowd stands so it feels like a proper World Cup game.

answers.ask: Is the rolling done on a screen, or do you want a physical draft room in the map to walk around in?
answers.answer: Do the rolling through a screen UI; players should be able to roll quickly with their infinite rolls.
